scientific_integrity: The claim is accompanied by an analytic all-positive-parameter proof, explicit assumptions, and independently constructed 16-dimensional Lindbladian numerical/exact-rational checks. Numerical sampling alone is not the proof. External independent verification and publication-priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for identical local zero-temperature amplitude damping and Pauli-Z dephasing, globally simultaneous ideal Bell-state Poisson resets, and unconditional two-qubit stationary CHSH with local projective observables. No statement on asymmetric channels, Hamiltonian coupling, filtering, detector losses, or general renewal resets. Priority uncertainty remains because standard general resetting and CHSH theory can implicitly support derivations.
title: A sharp Bell-nonlocality phase boundary under Poisson Bell-pair reinitialization and local decoherence
